Name: LOBBY_MENU_NPC_PARAM_ST
Description: Map pins of the lobby's NPCs: icon, alternate icon and the flags that show them.

Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 1 on the Wylder, Guardian, Duchess and Recluse rows.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of this NPC's pin on the Roundtable map. 0: no icon.

Fields.Name: Alternate Icon ID
Fields.Description: Second icon of the pin, used together with Use Alt Map Icon Flag. 0: none. Retail: set on 2 of 39 rows.

Fields.Name: Arrival Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that marks the NPC as present; passed with the pin. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Use Alt Map Icon Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag tied to the pin's alternate icon. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Hide Map Icon Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that hides the pin. -1 or 0: none.
